sectors.quote: The firm has raised 10 funds and invested EUR 2.5 billion in 163 companies, focusing on rapidly growing sectors such as technology, financial services, consumer goods, business services, healthcare, retail and manufacturing.

investments.quote: Enterprise Investors Fund IX (EIF IX) has agreed to invest up to EUR 21.8 million to acquire a stake of up to 81.51% in Kredito unija "Saulėgrąža", a Lithuanian financial institution.
Enterprise Investors Fund IX acquired a 65% stake in Art Wind, a Poland-based provider of wind turbine installation and maintenance services across Europe.
Enterprise Investors announced its investment in 18GYM in March and completed the transaction in June.
